added_lines: for further information. Youth 2000 Christmas Retreat | 11th–13th December 2026 Young people aged 16–35 are invited to the Youth 2000 Christmas Retreat at Newbridge College, Co. Kildare. Donation-only, with free buses nationwide and all meals included. All are welcome! Register at youth2000.ie Advent Night Prayer The Clergy of the Vicariate are gathering on the four Sundays of Advent for Night Prayer in Churches across the Vicariate at 7.00pm. We invite parishioners to join us if they can: Immaculate Heart of Mary Church 1st Sunday 29th Nov Good Shepherd Church 2nd Sunday 6th Dec St Colmcille’s Church 3rd Sunday 13th Dec St Brigid’s Church 4th Sunday 20th Dec Every Joy and Blessing to Sr. Catherine Cleary (Good Shepherd Contemplative Community) as she celebrates her 100 birthday .th St Bernadettes
